text: The purpose of this staff report is to seek City Council approval of the Woodbine Casino Lands – Woodbine Square at 555 Rexdale Boulevard (Block 9 of the Draft Plan of Subdivision) - Public Art Plan. The Plan, which is included as Attachment 1 of this report, outlines the method by which the owner will commission public art along the privately-owned area of the site. The Public Art Plan provides a framework and description of the commissioning of public art including: project description; history and culture of the area; public art requirement; public art objectives; public art locations; budget; selection process; jury composition and schedule. The attached plan meets the objectives of the City's Percent for Public Art Guidelines and is supported by the Toronto Public Art Commission.

City Council on June 15 and 16, 2022, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the 555 Rexdale Boulevard - Block 9 of the Draft Plan of Subdivision - Public Art Plan in Attachment 1 to the report (May 12, 2022) from the Director, Urban Design, City Planning.
